sources.disagreement: The earlier reader kept the role web with low confidence and a not-own-site flag; I find nothing in the copy about the November 2013 regional itself, so the site is not a source of this contest.

nanjing-2026.notes: Source 1 is the whole ICPC Beijing HQ site, not a site of the Nanjing contest itself; the address of source 2 (the invitation and registration guide page) is inside the copy of source 1 but source 2 has no copy of its own. Sources 4 and 7 are supporting data files of the scoreboard rather than results documents; roles left empty, a human may want to decide how to file them. The one-page invitation letter in source 1 has no text layer and was not read in full.

sources.evidence: The pages on the 51st Nanjing regional (notice list, allocation notice, invitation and registration guide) sit on the ICPC Beijing headquarters site, which also covers the other stations and earlier years.
The page is an empty application shell: a title, meta tags and script files, an empty app element and only a noscript line asking to enable JavaScript, with no scoreboard.
The file holds only contest settings (name, times, problem labels, medal counts) and no team or result rows.
Every run has team, problem, time in ms and verdict, so per-team per-problem results can be derived, but no ranked table is shown.
A JSON array of 374 team records with name, institution, group and members, and no results.
The file is a lookup list of 198 institution ids and names, not a list of teams.
The article names the first three places and the counts of official and invited teams for the 51st ICPC Asia Nanjing regional.
